scene.label: Act 3, Scene 4
scene.title: SCENE IV. Athens. A Room in Antony's House.
scene.location: Athens. A Room in Antony's House.

lines.text: Nay, nay, Octavia, not only that—
lines.plainText: Nay nay Octavia not only that

lines.text: That were excusable, that and thousands more
lines.plainText: That were excusable that and thousands more

lines.text: Of semblable import—but he hath waged
lines.plainText: Of semblable importbut he hath waged

lines.text: New wars 'gainst Pompey; made his will, and read it
lines.plainText: New wars 'gainst Pompey made his will and read it

lines.text: To public ear;
lines.plainText: To public ear

lines.text: Spoke scantly of me; when perforce he could not
lines.plainText: Spoke scantly of me when perforce he could not

lines.text: But pay me terms of honour, cold and sickly
lines.plainText: But pay me terms of honour cold and sickly

lines.text: He vented them; most narrow measure lent me;
lines.plainText: He vented them most narrow measure lent me

lines.text: When the best hint was given him, he not took 't,
lines.plainText: When the best hint was given him he not took 't

lines.text: Or did it from his teeth.
lines.plainText: Or did it from his teeth

lines.text: O, my good lord,
lines.plainText: O my good lord

lines.text: Believe not all, or if you must believe,
lines.plainText: Believe not all or if you must believe

lines.text: Stomach not all. A more unhappy lady,
lines.plainText: Stomach not all A more unhappy lady

lines.text: If this division chance, ne'er stood between,
lines.plainText: If this division chance ne'er stood between

lines.text: Praying for both parts.
lines.plainText: Praying for both parts

lines.text: The good gods will mock me presently
lines.plainText: The good gods will mock me presently

lines.text: When I shall pray "O, bless my lord and husband!"
lines.plainText: When I shall pray O bless my lord and husband

lines.text: Undo that prayer by crying out as loud
lines.plainText: Undo that prayer by crying out as loud

lines.text: "O, bless my brother!" Husband win, win brother,
lines.plainText: O bless my brother Husband win win brother

lines.text: Prays and destroys the prayer; no midway
lines.plainText: Prays and destroys the prayer no midway

lines.text: 'Twixt these extremes at all.
lines.plainText: 'Twixt these extremes at all

lines.text: Gentle Octavia,
lines.plainText: Gentle Octavia

lines.text: Let your best love draw to that point which seeks
lines.plainText: Let your best love draw to that point which seeks

lines.text: Best to preserve it. If I lose mine honour,
lines.plainText: Best to preserve it If I lose mine honour

lines.text: I lose myself; better I were not yours
lines.plainText: I lose myself better I were not yours

lines.text: Than yours so branchless. But, as you requested,
lines.plainText: Than yours so branchless But as you requested

lines.text: Yourself shall go between's. The meantime, lady,
lines.plainText: Yourself shall go between's The meantime lady

lines.text: I'll raise the preparation of a war
lines.plainText: I'll raise the preparation of a war

lines.text: Shall stain your brother. Make your soonest haste,
lines.plainText: Shall stain your brother Make your soonest haste

lines.text: So your desires are yours.
lines.plainText: So your desires are yours

lines.text: Thanks to my lord.
lines.plainText: Thanks to my lord

lines.text: The Jove of power make me, most weak, most weak,
lines.plainText: The Jove of power make me most weak most weak

lines.text: Your reconciler! Wars 'twixt you twain would be
lines.plainText: Your reconciler Wars 'twixt you twain would be

lines.text: As if the world should cleave, and that slain men
lines.plainText: As if the world should cleave and that slain men

lines.text: Should solder up the rift.
lines.plainText: Should solder up the rift

lines.text: When it appears to you where this begins,
lines.plainText: When it appears to you where this begins

lines.text: Turn your displeasure that way, for our faults
lines.plainText: Turn your displeasure that way for our faults

lines.text: Can never be so equal that your love
lines.plainText: Can never be so equal that your love

lines.text: Can equally move with them. Provide your going;
lines.plainText: Can equally move with them Provide your going

lines.text: Choose your own company, and command what cost
lines.plainText: Choose your own company and command what cost

lines.text: Your heart has mind to.
lines.plainText: Your heart has mind to
